user_query: I want to expand my shoe collection by finding unique and rare shoes along with their prices, images, descriptions, quantities, and ratings, as well as a reliable online store to purchase them.

TaskList.description: Search for unique and rare shoes including relevant details such as prices, images, descriptions, quantities, and ratings.
Fetch detailed information of each shoe item obtained from step 1, including their images and ratings.
Identify reliable online stores where the shoes can be purchased.
Compile and present the list of unique and rare shoes along with their detailed info and online store options.
